text: {"lessons":["Short-term price moves have been unpredictable, so I should not treat recent gains or losses as reliable forecasts.","Because losses bother me more than equal-sized gains please me, I should watch for loss aversion and make decisions based on a plan rather than discomfort.","I have rarely traded, and these periods alone do not show that trading would have improved results; I should avoid unnecessary trades and reassess deliberately."]}
